Hi, this is **Muhaimin**, **an economist by training and advertiser by profession** (umm what?!), **pivoting towards data science** (more umm what?!!). Currently I am studying in **UBC's Master of Data Science program.** My path here ran through a Master's in Economics, where a causal-impact study on COVID-19's effect on Bangladesh's macroeconomy first pulled me toward the field. Before circling back to it, I spent seven years as a creative professional in Bangladeshi advertising, learning how to turn complexity into things people actually understand. That combination is what I bring: **quantitative rigour with the communication craft** to match it. Long-term, I am drawn to high-stakes, data-rich domains like **energy markets, healthcare analytics, and derivatives,** where good models change real decisions and clear explanations of them are rare.
